name: custom-2
notes: 2026-09-17: personalized for more bass punch with stock pads and Apple Music; vocals/treble already satisfactory. Replaces custom's two bass peaks with a 120 Hz +7.5 dB low shelf and a 100 Hz +3 dB peak; preserves all eight other filters exactly in raw device Q. The 100 Hz device Q 1.43 approximates RBJ Q 1.2 after KA17 compensation; do not compensate again. Informed by oratory1990's Unveiled bass-shelf approach (https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/s1xm62zq2ap66psgi2l2g/Hifiman-Arya-Unveiled.pdf?rlkey=rhmk09kw95v4jislyih2na07r&dl=0) and Unheard Lab's bass/presence/5 kHz guidance (https://unheardlab.com/2025/08/18/hifiman-arya-unveiled-review-the-all-rounder-arya/); this is a personal adaptation, not either published preset. Preamp includes modeled headroom; shelf behavior and personal acoustic response are not measured. Compare at similar perceived vocal loudness, starting quietly.
